prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI session recovery login UI
Input image role: the visible source screenshot is a reference image for layout, state, and information architecture, not an edit target that must be pixel-preserved.
Primary request: Redesign 02-A-02-login/session-expired.
Direction: calm re-auth handoff.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 web app screenshot, no browser chrome and no OS window frame. The state should feel like a gentle re-auth handoff: form remains primary, notice explains why login is needed, and navigation remains clear. Include login CTA disabled/ready state affordance, social login option, password reset, and sign-up link.
Style/medium: high-fidelity web UI mockup, Ant Design Alert/Form/Input/Button patterns.
Color palette: Obsidian #09090b only for the main CTA; all other surfaces neutral Mist/Snow/Fog.
Typography: Cosmica-like single-family, weight-driven, compact density, no letter spacing.
Constraints: do not show raw provider messages, token/session identifiers, or scary security language; Korean UI copy is not final source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS window frame, AI gradients, saturated accent blocks, colorful CTAs, oversized bubble cards, watermark.
